title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Team Stealth Action
statusNote: Plays: loading screen, intro, title with the language flags, main menu, a new profile, mission select and briefing, then the first mission (T'bilisi), a 2D side-scroller in which Sam runs, jumps, crouches and draws and fires his pistol. Only the start of that mission was played.
notes: The title screen asks for a language with flags; 5 takes the highlighted one, and the first is English.
In the menus 5 selects and 7 goes back. A new profile asks for a three-letter name: confirm each letter with 5.
9 opens the inventory menu in play: vision mode, weapon, volume, Help (a drawing of the keys), Abort Mission and Exit. 9 closes it again.
The mission starts with a radio message that holds the controls until it has finished or you press 5.
2 Players needs a Bluetooth link to a second N-Gage and cannot work here.

controls.source: The game's Help screen (inventory menu, 9): move and run, activate device / hide in shadows / climb, crouch / rappel, jump on 5, sticky camera on 4, menu on 9. The pistol on 7 and the soft keys are not on that screen and were observed in the first mission; the menus name 5 and 7 themselves.

actions.up: Activate device, hide in shadows, climb
actions.7: Draw the pistol, then fire; back in menus
actions.9: Inventory menu (vision, weapon, help), and back to the game

notes: Side-scroller layout: move on the arrows, jump on X or Space, pistol on Z, sticky camera on C, menu on Tab. On a gamepad A jumps and selects, X is the pistol and goes back in menus, Y is the sticky camera and Start opens the menu.
